title: bignbit Dataset Configuration
description: Dataset configuration file for bignbit, as produced by scripts/create_dataset_config.py.

sendToHarmony.description: Whether the collection should be processed by the Harmony API.

operaHLSTreatment.description: Whether the collection should receive the OPERA HLS treatment.

imgVariables.description: Variables used to generate browse image(s). A single entry with id 'all' means use all variables.

id.description: Variable name (not a UMM-Var concept id), or 'all'.

height.description: Browse image height override for Harmony. Null when no dimensions override is given.

width.description: Browse image width override for Harmony. Null when no dimensions override is given.

subdaily.description: True if granules contain subdaily data (sends DataDateTime to GIBS).

outputCrs.description: Output projections / coordinate reference systems for browse images.

reprojection.description: Force reprojection for all granules (unconditionally send outputCrs in Harmony calls).

requesterPays.description: True if the source data bucket is configured as requester-pays.

collectionId.description: CMR collection concept id. Venue-specific. Present only when supplied.

imageFilenameRegex.description: Regex identifying which file in a granule is the image file. Present only when supplied.

nrtFilenameRegex.description: Regex identifying whether a granule is NRT vs standard. Present only when supplied.

scaleExtentPolar.description: Geographic extent [minX, minY, maxX, maxY] for polar-projected outputs. Present only when supplied.

singleDayNumber.description: Day-of-year (e.g. '001') applied to all granules in the dataset. Present only when supplied.

dataDayStrategy.description: Set to 'single_day_of_year' automatically when singleDayNumber is present.

if.comment: sendToHarmony present and true selects the Harmony branch of the state machine.

then.comment: Harmony branch: imgVariables backs the Map ItemsPath in the state machine and fails at runtime if absent.

else.comment: Non-Harmony branch (sendToHarmony absent or false): identify_image_file reads imageFilenameRegex with no default and raises KeyError if absent.
